text:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: P99 latency spike for customer: BlueHarbor Financial (dedicated pool blu-hbr-eu3). Current p99 12.4s (SLO 5s) — affected routes: /v1/generate (all models). Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD-91234 :rotating_light:

ayesha_oncall: I'm on it. Paging SRE + runtime. @ben_sre @carlos_runtime please jump in.

ben_sre: pulling graphs now. can you confirm it's only BlueHarbor or pan-customer?

ayesha_oncall: Pager shows tenant-scoped surge, looks isolated to blu-hbr-eu3 dedicated pool. Host metrics: GPU utilization ~98%, queue depth spiked.

carlos_runtime: seeing CPU steal on the host side + kernel fallback thrashing on a subset of workers. logs: `tensorflow-infer: KV-cache miss flood, eviction races`.

jess_cs: I let BlueHarbor contact know we've opened an incident. They report increased timeouts from their users in EU. They need an ETA for mitigation — I told them we'll update in 15.

ben_sre: plan (short): 1) tenant isolation to cap concurrency 2) warm-failover routing to standby region eu-west-1 3) scale dedicated pool by +2 GPUs if capacity available. Doing step 1 now.

ben_sre: kicking off tenant isolation rule: `rictl routing update --pool=bllu-hbr-eu3 --tenant=blueharbor --max-concurrency=8`

ops-bot: command accepted, applying rule to loadbalancer.

ayesha_oncall: isolating at edge now. Confirming requests queued for BlueHarbor are being limited.

carlos_runtime: I recommend forcing quantized variant for this tenant to cut per-token latency — lower perf but far fewer ops. Deploying model variant v2-q8 for tenant.

ben_sre: rolling the routing change to send 40% of traffic to eu-west-1 standby (weighted failover) to reduce pressure.

jess_cs: BlueHarbor asked if we can keep session affinity. I'm saying we can preserve cookies for in-flight sessions but new sessions may be routed. They accepted.

mark_se: checking Dedicated capacity pool quotas — we have 2 spare GPUs in same region in reserved pool, requesting scale now.

ops-bot: pool scale request queued: `rictl pool scale --pool=blu-hbr-eu3 --add=2` (eta 90s).

carlos_runtime: while scale spins up, I'm adjusting kernel selection to prefer lower-memory kernels (reduce eviction). Patch applied to 6 workers.

ben_sre: monitoring p95/p99... p95 dropped from 3.6s -> 1.9s after isolation + quantized swap. p99 still at 6.8s but trending down.

pagerduty-bot: STATUS UPDATE: incident PD-91234 assigned to ayesha_oncall.

ayesha_oncall: handoff note — if p99 remains >5s after 15m, escalate to infra oncall and implement full migrate-to-standby policy (100% traffic shift).

diana_oncall: I'm taking over steady-state mitigation for the night at 18:00 UTC. Will monitor the route and be ready to cutover if p99 stays >5s. @ayesha_oncall please confirm any sticky sessions that must not be moved.

jess_cs: BlueHarbor: they have a small set of long-lived sessions (trading desks) — we need to preserve those. I'll coordinate exact session cookies with you in DM.

ben_sre: after scale finished, pool GPU util dropped to 74%, p99 is 3.2s. Good. Keep in monitoring for 30m.

carlos_runtime: left a short-term patch to KV-cache warmup: prefetch top-200 prefixes from their most common prompt sets. Added cron job: `curl https://tools.internal/warm?tenant=blueharbor&count=200`

ops-bot: pool scale completed. New capacity online.

mark_se: filing follow-up action item: capacity reservation for BlueHarbor traffic spikes (recommend +1 GPU warm spare) — creating ticket SE-4821.

ayesha_oncall: summary for handoff: isolation rule applied, quantized variant deployed for tenant, +2 GPUs added, warm-cache prefetch enabled, standby weighted failover at 40%. Immediate customer impact reduced (p99 3.2s). Diana, take it from here and escalate if p99 >5s for 10m straight.

diana_oncall: ack. I'll post a 30m check-in and escalate to infra if needed.

pagerduty-bot: RESOLVE: PD-91234 resolved for now (condition recovered below SLO). Incident will remain open for RCA and capacity follow-up.

ayesha_oncall: closing notes: RCA candidate: tenant-wide request pattern changed (spiky batch jobs from client-side scheduler at minute boundaries) + kernel eviction amplification on older worker image. Follow-ups: 1) recommend BlueHarbor staggered scheduling best-practice, 2) infra image rebuild to include eviction fix, 3) reserve warm spare + update routing playbook.

jess_cs: I'll coordinate the customer playbook changes and the staggered schedule advice.

ben_sre: creating postmortem draft, linking logs and metrics. Ticket PM-91234 in progress.

diana_oncall: handoff accepted. I'll watch the alert channel and ping if we see reoccur. Good job team. :thumbsup:
